projectTitle: Sleep Studio: A Magento store for a mattress line
project_haiku: Sleep Studio sells gel and copper-infused foam, with a 100-night trial. We built the Magento store so a buyer can compare a topper, a pillow, and a bundle and check out.
project_footer_CTA: Need a product catalog that explains a physical product and then gets out of the way of the cart? Sleep Studio is that shop.
pageSummary:
The job

Sleep Studio sells the SleepJoy line: gel memory foam, copper-infused foam, toppers, and pillows, made in the U.S. The brand offers a 100-night trial and free shipping. The site had to explain the materials and make the purchase obvious.

What we built

The store is Magento. Categories cover toppers, pillows, and seasonal groups such as back-to-college. Landing pages use the product photography and the material claims. A buyer can move from a category to a product to checkout without a second explanation of the same foam.

Outcomes

The catalog matches the line. The trial and the materials are on the page where the decision happens.
